name: Anaconda
description: Anaconda, widely known in home games as 'Pass the Trash,' is a high-action poker variant characterized by multiple passing rounds and a dramatic 'rollout' showdown. Unlike traditional poker, players actively sabotage their opponents during the passing phases, making it a game of social manipulation and tactical hand-building.

content.text: Anaconda, widely known in home games as 'Pass the Trash,' is a high-action poker variant characterized by multiple passing rounds and a dramatic 'rollout' showdown. Unlike traditional poker, players actively sabotage their opponents during the passing phases, making it a game of social manipulation and tactical hand-building.
A staple of 'Dealer's Choice' home poker games in the United States. It likely emerged in the mid-20th century as players sought to add more interaction to standard Seven-Card Stud.
Best with 6-8 players to ensure many cards are 'trashed'.
Each player receives 7 cards face down. Initial ante or forced bets are placed.

items.text: Anaconda 8-or-Better: Pot is split between the high hand and the best low hand containing no card higher than an 8.
Simple Pass the Trash: Only one round of passing (usually 3 cards) before the discard and rollout.
